com.sun.media.sound

类 DLSInfo

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.media.sound.DLSInfo

  • public final class DLSInfo
extends Object
    This class is used to store information to describe soundbanks, instruments and samples. It is stored inside a "INFO" List Chunk inside DLS files.
    作者:
    Karl Helgason
